svg.title: decay-masks
svg.desc: Effective weight on past token j for query t, D_tj = product of the decays between them, on 12 toy tokens. No decay: every past token keeps full weight. Fixed decay 0.8: weights fade with distance. Input-dependent decay 0.95 except 0.1 at token 5 and 0.5 at token 9: the small decay at token 5 cuts almost every path that crosses it.
